clauses.clause: L7 roster and arsenal arrive exactly; companions at full health; no weapon pickup in L8; start weapon = last weapon (not the bat).
clauses.note: Actual current native L7-to-L8 carryovers preserve all23 low/24 high human IDs, exact rack order and selected rocket launcher (not bat). Every human and companion arrives at its own full HP (including four low-tier60/60 companions in the human roster); corgi100/100. L8 starts with zero pickup entities, both full actual L8 routes leave the arsenal unchanged, and independent current canonical receipts record zero weapon pickups. Low uses successful current L5/L6/L7 progression; high uses the current canonical L7-default completion after the separately retained23-follower carried-high prefix failed. This qualifies the production handover contract for those actual completed cohorts, not the rejected prefix or a physical whole-game journey.
